tools.name: health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies WAHA connectivity and lists active sessions.

tools.name: session-status
tools.description: Get the status of a WhatsApp session. Status can be: WORKING, SCAN_QR_CODE, STARTING, STOPPED, FAILED. SCAN_QR_CODE means the session is waiting to be linked — use request-pairing-code (authentication is always done with a pairing code, never QR).

tools.name: start-session
tools.description: Start a WhatsApp session. Creates it if it does not exist. If the session is in FAILED state, it will be stopped and restarted automatically. After starting, use request-pairing-code to link the device — authentication is always done with a pairing code (QR is not supported).

tools.name: stop-session
tools.description: Stop a WhatsApp session without deleting it. The session can be restarted later with start-session.

tools.name: request-pairing-code
tools.description: Request a numeric pairing code to link a WhatsApp session. This is the ONLY supported way to authenticate/link a session in Teros. The session must be in SCAN_QR_CODE state — WAHA's "waiting to be linked" state (if not, it will be stopped and restarted automatically). Returns an 8-digit code like "XXXX-YYYY" to enter in WhatsApp → Linked Devices → Link with phone number.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number with country code, no + or spaces (e.g. "34612345678")

tools.name: send-text
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp text message to a phone number or group.

tools.name: send-image
tools.description: Send an image to a WhatsApp chat from a public URL.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the image to send

mimetype.description: Optional MIME type of the image (e.g. "image/jpeg", "image/png")

tools.name: send-document
tools.description: Send a document or file (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, etc.) to a WhatsApp chat from a public URL or a local /workspace/ path.

chatId.description: Recipient chat ID (e.g. 34612345678@c.us for individuals, 120363XXXXXX@g.us for groups)

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the file to send, or a local path starting with /workspace/ (e.g. "/workspace/report.pdf")

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient (e.g. "report.pdf")

mimetype.description: MIME type of the file (e.g. "application/pdf", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"). Defaults to "application/octet-stream".

caption.description: Optional caption text shown below the file

tools.name: get-messages
tools.description: Get recent messages from a WhatsApp chat.

offset.description: Number of messages to skip (for pagination)

filter.timestamp.lte.description: Filter messages with timestamp <= this value (Unix timestamp)

filter.timestamp.gte.description: Filter messages with timestamp >= this value (Unix timestamp)

filter.fromMe.description: Filter messages by direction: true = sent by me, false = received

tools.name: get-chats
tools.description: List all WhatsApp chats (conversations) in a session.

offset.description: Number of chats to skip for pagination (default: 0)

tools.name: get-contacts
tools.description: Get all contacts from a WhatsApp session.

offset.description: Number of contacts to skip for pagination (default: 0)

tools.name: check-number
tools.description: Check if a phone number has WhatsApp and get its chat ID.

tools.name: get-labels
tools.description: List all labels available in a WhatsApp Business session. Labels are used to organize chats. Only available in WhatsApp Business accounts.

tools.name: get-chat-labels
tools.description: Get all labels assigned to a specific WhatsApp chat. Returns an array of label objects with id, name, color, and colorHex. Only available in WhatsApp Business accounts.

chatId.description: Chat ID (e.g. 34612345678@c.us for individuals, 120363XXXXXX@g.us for groups)

tools.name: put-chat-labels
tools.description: Set (replace) the labels assigned to a WhatsApp chat. You must provide the FULL list of labels to assign — any labels not included will be removed. Pass an empty array to remove all labels. Only available in WhatsApp Business accounts.

chatId.description: Chat ID (e.g. 34612345678@c.us for individuals, 120363XXXXXX@g.us for groups)

labels.description: Full list of labels to assign to the chat. Each item must have an "id" field (e.g. [{ "id": "1" }, { "id": "2" }]). Pass an empty array [] to remove all labels.

tools.name: search-chats
tools.description: Search WhatsApp chats by name or phone number. Filters client-side over the full chat list.

query.description: Text to search in chat name or chat ID (case-insensitive)

limit.description: Max chats to fetch before filtering (default: 200)

tools.name: download-media
tools.description: Download media (image, audio, video, document) from a WhatsApp message. Fetches the message by ID to get the media URL, then downloads the file and saves it to the specified output path. Requires the message to have hasMedia: true.

chatId.description: Chat ID where the message was received (e.g. "34612345678@c.us"). Use "all" for GOWS/NOWEB if chatId is unknown.

outputPath.description: Local path where the file will be saved (e.g. "/workspace/archivo.pdf"). /workspace/ is a shared volume accessible to all agents.

tools.name: reaction
tools.description: Send or remove a reaction (emoji) to a WhatsApp message.

messageId.description: ID of the message to react to

reaction.description: Emoji to react with (e.g. "👍"). Pass empty string "" to remove a reaction.

tools.name: read-messages
tools.description: Mark messages in a WhatsApp chat as read. If no message IDs are provided, marks all messages in the chat as read.

chatId.description: Chat ID (e.g. 34612345678@c.us for individuals, 120363XXXXXX@g.us for groups)

messages.description: Optional list of message IDs to mark as read. If omitted, all messages in the chat are marked as read.

days.description: Optional number of days back to mark messages as read.

tools.name: mark-unread
tools.description: Mark a WhatsApp chat as unread (shows the blue dot indicator).

chatId.description: Chat ID (e.g. 34612345678@c.us for individuals, 120363XXXXXX@g.us for groups)

tools.name: get-profile
tools.description: Get the profile of the current WhatsApp account (name, picture URL, status/About text, etc.).

tools.name: set-profile-name
tools.description: Change the display name of the current WhatsApp profile.

tools.name: set-profile-status
tools.description: Change the "About" status text of the current WhatsApp profile.

tools.name: set-profile-picture
tools.description: Set the profile picture of the current WhatsApp account from a public image URL.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the image to use as profile picture

tools.name: delete-profile-picture
tools.description: Delete the profile picture of the current WhatsApp account.

tools.name: get-contact-profile-picture
tools.description: Get the profile picture URL of a WhatsApp contact.

refresh.description: Force a refresh of the cached picture (optional)

tools.name: search-contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by name or phone number. Returns matches ordered by most recent interaction first (top 5), then remaining matches up to limit.

query.description: Search term to match against contact name, pushName, or phone number (e.g. "antonio" or "346123")

tools.name: get-unread-chats
tools.description: Return chats that have unread messages, ordered by unread count (desc). Supports pagination.

limit.description: Max chats to return per page (default: 20)

offset.description: Number of chats to skip for pagination (default: 0)
